name: capability-diff
description: Compares who can run each operation of a WordPress plugin or theme (AJAX and admin-post actions, REST routes, admin pages) in two versions, and reports the changes that let more users in: a removed or lowered capability check, a dropped object ID, a check moved after the write, a route made public, a removed nonce.
author: Hamza Ahmad Aslam (https://hamzaahmadaslam.com)
